subject: Auriga Biomed — one-off packaging & discount exception request
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Auriga Biomed — one-off packaging & discount exception request

Team,

Quick background: Auriga Biomed is a strategic prospect (clinical research platform) we've been engaged with for ~6 weeks. They want Redwood Private (VPC + dedicated capacity) for an 18-month pilot tied to a multi-product rollout across 3 regions. Their procurement has signaled that price is the gating factor to get the legal/IT procurement kickoff this quarter.

Current ask from customer: a one-time front-loaded discount of 35% off list for Year 1, plus waiver of standard packaging fees for onboarding (they want seat migration + VPC setup included). Committed minimum spend during pilot is $250,000. They are also asking for a 6-month data retention extension and a redaction clause in the DPA.

Why we consider exception: closing this pilot opens a path to a $2.6M ARR commercial contract in 18 months (customer roadmap + references). They are willing to sign a case study clause and a 12-month follow-on renewal guarantee at list rates after pilot.

Request to leadership: need VP/CFO sign-off for discount >30% and packaging waiver. I have attached a margin impact workbook and a draft mutual action plan that includes the case study and renewal term.

Proposed alternative we can offer if full approval is not granted: 1) cap discount at 30% with the remainder converted into a usage credit redeemable in Q1/Q2 of next year, 2) require proof-of-concept milestones with incremental payouts, 3) add a renewal pricing floor (no lower than 85% of list).

Attachments: auriga_margin_impact.xlsx (margin model, assumptions), draft MAP (in my drive link).

Next step: Kimberly, can you advise on commercial precedent? Marissa, could you run a quick P&L delta for 30% vs 35% and confirm whether Finance needs a formal memo? Markus, tagging you for CFO threshold.

Thanks,
Dev
Dev Patel | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:12:43 -0700
Subject: Re: Auriga Biomed — one-off packaging & discount exception request

Dev —

Thanks for the summary. A couple quick questions before I escalate to commercial exemptions:

- Can you confirm the procurement timeline? Are they asking to sign before end-of-quarter (EoQ) or do they require legal review first?
- Do we have precedent for waiving packaging for Private deployments at this discount level?
- What are the customer success/ops risks with the extended retention and redaction asks — do we need additional SOW hours?

Marissa, please produce a concise P&L delta (one-pager) that shows revenue, gross margin impact, and NPV at both 30% and 35% discount levels. If this crosses the CFO charter (>30%), then we need an exec memo with recommendation + mitigations.

If we move forward with anything above 30% I will need an explicit ask and the business rationale (new logos, reference potential, expansion runway) documented.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park | VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Kimberly/Dev/Markus —

Attached is the margin delta workbook you asked for (auriga_margin_impact.xlsx). High-level summary in bullet form:

- At 30% discount: Year 1 recognized revenue = $175k (on $250k committed), gross margin ~52% (after direct onboarding/ops). NPV (3 yr, 10% discount) for this pilot ~ $190k.
- At 35% discount: Year 1 recognized revenue = $162.5k, gross margin dips to ~46%. NPV delta vs 30% = -$20k.
- Waiving packaging adds ~$18k of upfront cost (engineering/onboarding hours + VPC setup).

Finance threshold: anything that reduces expected gross margin by more than 8 points or causes NPV deterioration beyond $50k requires CFO sign-off. This case currently triggers CFO review because the combined effect of a 35% discount + packaging waiver pushes our margin compression close to that threshold, depending on the final SOW.

Recommendation: approve a 28%–30% one-time discount with the packaging fees converted into a time-boxed credit applied against onboarding invoices (reduces upfront cash hit). Require the case study clause and a renewal pricing floor in the contract.

Attachment: auriga_margin_impact.xlsx (contains assumptions sheet, sensitivity tables, and recommended guardrails).

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Finance Manager, Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference

Kimberly/Marissa/Dev —

Thanks for the diligence and the numbers, Marissa. I reviewed the workbook and the stated expansion upside. I’m willing to authorize an exception but with tighter guardrails than requested by the customer. Approvals below: 

- Approved discount: up to 28% one-time on Year 1 list for the pilot (not 35%).
- Packaging: waive 50% of onboarding packaging fees; remaining 50% to be invoiced and can be rebated on achievement of two deployment milestones (24/72 hour SLA onboarding completion and production launch).
- Contract conditions required: 1) signed case study / reference clause, 2) documented renewal floor (no lower than 90% of list for first renewal), 3) prepayment of 50% of committed pilot spend at signing or a letter of credit.

I also want the legal team to limit the redaction clause scope — full enterprise redaction is not acceptable without additional controls. Ask customer legal for a narrowed scope and include SOC 2 evidence only.

Marissa — please prepare a short CFO exception memo (one page) that I can sign which includes the narrowed ask, margin impact at 28%, and the mitigations above. Kimberly, once Marissa has the memo, please route to me for signature.

-Markus

Lizbeth — looping you in. Per our internal review, Redwood can move forward on a capped exception with the following commercial points: 

- One-time pilot discount: 28% off Year 1 list (applies only to committed minimum spend of $250k).
- Packaging: 50% waiver on onboarding fees; remaining 50% invoiced but eligible for rebate after two deployment milestones (onboarding SLA & production launch).
- Contract conditions: signed case study clause, a renewal floor at 90% of list for the first renewal, and 50% prepayment at signing or equivalent LC.
- Redaction/data retention: Redwood legal requests a narrowed redaction scope; we will provide SOC 2 evidence and discuss a limited retention extension if acceptable controls are in place.

Lizbeth, can you confirm whether Auriga is able to accept the above and proceed to legal? If yes, I will coordinate a short CFO exception memo and route it for signature.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this one.
